Each is compared on published per-seat price and listed add-ons, SMS allowances, CRM integrations, AI call handling and support, using each provider's own pricing pages and docs, checked on November 24, 2026.

+Published entry prices run from $10 (Nextiva Go) to $20 (RingCentral RingEX Core) per user per month on annual billing, with CloudTalk Starter at €25 (as of November 2026). The entry plan often leaves out the things teams buy a phone system for: texting volume, CRM integrations, 24/7 phone support and AI call answering.

+Disclosure: Retell AI publishes this list, and Retell AI is one of the nine products in it, placed first. Retell AI is an AI voice agent platform that works on top of a phone system, so it is not a like-for-like alternative to the other eight.
